title.narrative: PERFORMANCE-BASED PARTNERSHIP SCHEME FOCUSING ON QUALITY PROGRAMMING, UNDERSTANDING CHANGE AND RESULTS FOR POOR HOUSEHOLDS AND COMMUNITIES

description.narrative: The ICSP Programme in Borena, South Omo, Addis Ababa and Tigray, implemented by Trócaire aims to contribute to Outcome 3.1: Women and older adolescent girls experience increased safety, psychosocial wellbeing, and meaningful participation and leadership. Activities and the objective include support to Self Help Groups (SHG), provide literacy, gender equality, women’s rights and family law training, support dialogue with elders duty bearers and change agents on gender equality and, develop a women centred organisation (WCO) strategy followed by support to WCOs. So, women and older adolescent girls’ voice and leadership is increased in all spheres. ---- The principal focus of this objective is:- Women’s empowerment and participation in decision making spaces- Reduce social, economic or political power inequalities between women and men, girls and boys- Compensate for past discrimination- Support to women’s equality organisations and institutions
